plugins.name: referee-preview
plugins.description: See what referees will object to before you submit: a three-lane review of a condensed matter paper and a dashboard to work through it.

plugins.name: lab-notes
plugins.description: An AI lab notebook for experimental physics: dictate notes, photos and instrument runs into a record where every number cites its source; procedure manuals from dictation; plots the lab's way.

plugins.name: project-advisor
plugins.description: Choose between your own research ideas: assumptions with risk and readout time, the closest prior work on arXiv, your own estimates of odds, impact and time, and a dashboard showing the uncertainty that would most change your choice and the cheapest test that resolves it.
